map.百分等级计算器：输入数值与数据集，计算该值低于总体中多少比例的数据（百分等级），: The percentile rank calculator takes a value and a data set and computes the share of the data below that value (the percentile rank), used for grade and ranking assessment.
map.PR=(低于数+0.5×等于数)/N×100。: PR = (number below + 0.5 x number equal) / N x 100.
map.某分数在群体中的相对位置。: The relative position of a score within a group.
map.成绩、身高的\"超过百分之多少\"。: "What percentage taller/better" for grades and height.
map.：30 人中 12 人低于 80、3 人等于 80：PR=(12+0.5×3)/: Of 30 people, 12 scored below 80 and 3 scored exactly 80: PR = (12 + 0.5 x 3)/30 x 100 = 13.5/30 x 100 = 45, so about 45% of people scored lower (the 45th percentile).
map.：若无人高于：PR=(29+0.5×1)/30×100≈98.3。: If nobody scored higher: PR = (29 + 0.5 x 1)/30 x 100 = about 98.3.
map.由两组样本量方差求合并方差: Pooled variance from two sample variances
map.由事件概率求其补事件概率: Complement probability from an event probability
map.百分位 P_k 是\"第 k% 的人低于此值\"的分数；百分等级是某分数对应的: The k-th percentile is the score below which k% of people fall; a percentile rank is the k corresponding to a given score, and the two are inverse functions of each other.
map.把等于自身的半个人计入排名，避免把自身算作\"低于\"，是常用经验修正。: Counting the value equal to itself as half a person avoids treating yourself as "below", which is a common empirical correction.
